specification.objective: Allow users to edit and safely delete Prisma session tags.

requirements.statement: The Prisma tag-management UI lets users edit a tag's name, emoji, and color while preserving its ID and existing assignments; assigned sessions receive the edited color.
The Prisma tag-management UI lets users delete a tag only after explicit confirmation; deletion removes its session assignments and clears the corresponding session color overrides.

acceptance_criteria.statement: Editing a tag persists validated name, emoji, and color under the same tag ID, preserves assignments, and updates the color override for every assigned session.

A destructive ConfirmDialog gates tag deletion; confirming removes the tag and only its assignments, clears affected session color overrides, and preserves other tags, their assignments, and legacy emoji data.

invariants.statement: Creating, assigning, clearing, rendering, and persisting tags continues to work; editing never changes a tag ID or its session mappings.
Deleting a tag does not change profile colors, unrelated tags or assignments, session records, or preserved legacy emoji-only assignments.

forbidden_states.statement: An invalid tag edit is persisted or a tag is deleted before the user confirms the destructive action.
A deleted tag remains referenced by sessionTags or leaves a stale Prisma session color override.

inputs.statement: An existing tag ID and edited name, single emoji, and six-digit hexadecimal color, or a tag ID selected for deletion.
The current per-session tag assignments and session color overrides for the selected tag.

outputs.statement: An updated tag definition with stable ID and refreshed assigned-session colors, or a confirmed deletion with matching session assignments and color overrides cleared.

failure_semantics.statement: Invalid fields or an unknown tag ID cause no persistence or color changes; canceling deletion leaves the tag and its assignments unchanged.

baseline_output_contains: edit tag updates definition and session colors
delete confirmation clears all tag assignments and overrides
